{
  function pad2(n) { return n < 10 ? '0' + n : n }
  function min30(n) { return n < 30 ? '0' : '30' }

  var date = new Date();
  var now = date.getFullYear().toString() + pad2(date.getMonth() + 1) + pad2(date.getDate()) + pad2(date.getHours()) + pad2(min30(date.getMinutes()));

  fetch('https://images.cwtv.com/feed/app-2/landing/epg/page_1/pagesize_75/device_web/apiversion_18/cacheversion_' + now)
    .then(res => res.json())
    .then(data => data.channels)
    .then(channels => channels.map(channel => ({
      slug: channel.slug,
      title: channel.title,
      description: channel.description,
      stream_url: channel.stream_url,
      programs: channel.programs.map(program => ({
        title: program.title,
        subtitle: program.subtitle,
        description: program.description,
        duration_secs: program.duration_secs,
        program_start_ts: program.program_start_ts,
        program_end_ts: program.program_end_ts
      }))
    })))
    .then(channels => {console.log(JSON.stringify(channels, null, 2))})
}

// ===============
// notes:
// ===============

* units for "program_start_ts" and "program_end_ts" are seconds
    const program_start_ts = new Date(program.program_start_ts * 1000)
    const program_end_ts   = new Date(program.program_end_ts   * 1000)

* format "duration_secs" to HH:MM
    function pad2(n) { return n < 10 ? '0' + n : n }
    function format_duration(program) {
      let mins, hour
      mins = Math.floor(program.duration_secs / 60)
      hour = Math.floor(mins / 60)
      mins = mins % 60
      return [
        pad2(hour),
        pad2(mins)
      ].join(':')
    }
    // ex: format_duration({duration_secs: 2968})
